workflow.execution: five independent launch-set generations using the gameplay capture and clean plaza references, followed by two direction-specific world-prop generations using each matching UI portal plus the clean plaza map
workflow.transparencyStrategy: flat #00FF00 or #FF00FF chroma-key generation followed by local chroma removal
workflow.notes: The built-in generator returned 1254x1254 RGB PNGs. Each selected chroma-key source was resized first, then converted to an alpha PNG with the installed ImageGen chroma-removal helper. The west/east wall variants are separately authored 55-degree three-quarter world props; they are not affine transforms of the UI icons. No CLI image model or model-native transparency was used.

referenceImages.role: current gameplay composition, existing plaza UI density, portal placement, and overall gothic ARPG style reference; not an edit target
referenceImages.versionControl: external conversation input; the capture-time local path is not durable, so SHA-256 and image metadata are the canonical identity

referenceImages.role: clean plaza architecture, black-stone and aged-metal materials, banner language, lighting, and isometric game-camera context; not an edit target

promptAssembly.rule: For each built-in generation call, concatenate commonPrompt, then the matching requestPrompt. Supply both reference images in the order listed above.
promptAssembly.commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D game asset for the shared plaza of a dark gothic action RPG
Input images: Image 1 is the current gameplay/UI/style reference. Use it only to understand the live scene, UI density, portal placement, and early-2000s gothic ARPG art direction. Image 2 is the clean plaza environment/material/camera reference. Use it only for black-stone architecture, aged metal, banners, warm practical lighting, and the way large props read in the isometric plaza. Create a new isolated asset; do not reproduce characters, nameplates, menus, labels, or the reference images' complete composition.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat, uniform solid #00FF00 chroma-key background for later removal. No gradient, texture, floor plane, horizon, reflection, cast shadow, contact shadow, fog, or lighting variation in the green. Do not use #00FF00 in the asset.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D dark-fantasy ARPG production art; blackened carved stone, forged iron, restrained aged bronze and antique gold, believable wear, crisp silhouettes, and dense detail that remains readable after downscaling. Match the game's solemn occult sanctuary rather than a clean modern UI or cartoon style.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered, front-facing asset on a square canvas, fully visible with generous even chroma-key padding on every side. Keep the silhouette symmetric and suitable for compositing over the plaza canvas or DOM UI.
Lighting/mood: restrained warm edge light and localized magical emissive light only; deep blacks, strong value separation, no global bloom washing out the materials.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, characters, creatures, detached debris, extra props outside the requested asset, cropped edges, perspective tilt, premade game branding, or decorative scene background. Preserve a clean continuous green moat around the entire visible silhouette.

requests.requestPrompt: Primary request: create one large square gothic sanctuary HUD frame with an enormous calm rectangular opening in the center for live HTML content. Build the frame from layered blackened iron and carved dark stone with thin aged-bronze rims, compact beveled corner armor, small ember-red gems near the corners, restrained occult engraving, a narrow pointed sanctuary crest centered at the top, and a smaller matching point centered at the bottom. Add two slim, dark crimson hanging-cloth insets low on the side pillars, integrated into the frame rather than floating. The central opening must occupy most of the canvas and remain completely unobstructed green so it becomes transparent. Keep all ornament inside a consistent frame thickness and make the four sides visually continuous for border-image or full-frame rendering. Avoid text, skulls, giant wings, oversized gemstones, bright fire, thick columns that consume the content area, broken corners, and any object inside the center opening.

Primary request: create one monumental expedition portal for the north side of the plaza. Use a tall pointed black-stone arch reinforced with forged iron and thin aged-gold runic trim, a restrained spear-like crown, symmetrical side buttresses, dark crimson expedition banners, chains, and two small brazier pedestals. Inside the opening, render a deep crimson-red magical rift with a warm ivory core and controlled ember specks. The silhouette must feel dangerous, aspirational, and suitable for THE ENDLESS EXPEDITION, using the runtime identity colors #DE5662 and #FFD7A2 without text. Keep the lower threshold readable and the complete portal isolated; no surrounding wall, floor, player, signage, floating title, or green contamination inside the stonework.

Primary request: create one severe ritual duel portal. Use a tall pointed blackened-steel and dark-stone arch with cold silver edges, aggressive symmetric spires, an amethyst rune crest, and two monumental vertical sword ornaments integrated into the side towers. Inside the opening, render a dense violet-black energy veil with a bright amethyst core and restrained branching arcane filaments. The silhouette must communicate competitive MEMORY DUEL combat, discipline, and lethal symmetry, using the runtime identity colors #8D5CFF and #D6C2FF without text. Keep every sword and spire attached to the structure and the full base visible; no combatants, shields, arena scene, blood, lettering, floating UI, surrounding floor, or cropped blades.

Primary request: create one dignified memory-exchange portal. Use a tall dark-masonry arch with aged-brass trim, restrained civic-gothic towers, a balanced-scales crest at the crown, fine chain motifs, green wax-seal or coin details, two closed ledger books on symmetric stone desks, and small antique vessels integrated at the lower sides. Inside the opening, render a deep teal crystalline rift with a soft warm-white core and subtle geometric currents. The silhouette must communicate a trustworthy occult market and MEMORY EXCHANGE, using the runtime identity colors #42D8C5 and #D1FFF4 without text. Keep trade symbols decorative and secondary; no loose coins, price labels, shopkeeper, stalls, readable book text, modern banking imagery, surrounding floor, or cropped props.

Primary request: create one inviting but still solemn memory-caravan portal. Use a tall black-stone travel arch with aged-bronze and antique-gold edging, a compass-rose crest, compact side spires, dark burgundy travel pennants, chains, and warm hanging lanterns. Integrate a small, orderly cluster of expedition luggage at the lower sides: closed reinforced chests, one leather pack, and rolled supplies, all attached visually to the portal base and never blocking the doorway. Inside the opening, render a luminous amber-gold rift with a warm ivory core and controlled swirling light. The silhouette must communicate supplies, account services, and MEMORY CARAVAN travel, using the runtime identity colors #E8AD48 and #FFF0BB without text. No merchant, wagon, horse, scattered loot, labels, readable compass letters, surrounding floor, or cropped luggage.

worldSpaceVariants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated production game-world sprite for the Memory Plaza canvas, square source for a 768x768 RGBA cutout
Primary request: Create a world-only MEMORY DUEL portal designed to be installed in the WEST wall of the plaza. It must be a genuinely oblique environment prop, not a front-facing UI icon.
Input images:
- Image 1 is the design reference: preserve its blackened gothic stone-and-metal construction, blade-like silver trim, violet crystals, luminous purple memory rift, and premium dark-fantasy identity.
- Image 2 is the environment/perspective reference: match its hand-painted ARPG rendering, warm low-key ambient lighting, masonry scale, and approximately 55-degree top-down three-quarter camera.
Subject and orientation: One complete freestanding portal/doorway structure. The portal opening faces east/right toward the plaza center as a west-wall gate. View it obliquely from above and from the southeast, so the top planes, depth of the arch, east-facing facade, and receding west-wall side thickness are visibly readable. Vertical pillars remain upright; the stone base is foreshortened consistently with the plaza map. Preserve a strong purple emissive core while keeping the full architectural silhouette readable.
Composition: Center the full structure in a 1:1 canvas with generous 8-10% clear margin on every edge. Include every spire, both pillars, complete base stones, and full rift aperture. No cropping. No surrounding wall segment, floor tile, ground plane, cast shadow, or contact shadow.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform color with no gradient, texture, haze, shadow, reflection, floor, or lighting variation.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted dark fantasy ARPG environment sprite, high material detail, sharp silhouette, production-ready at game scale; match the plaza map rather than a glossy UI render.
Lighting/mood: restrained warm bronze edge light from plaza lanterns plus deep violet portal emission; emission stays inside and immediately around the structure without smoke or transparent wisps extending far into the key background.
Constraints: use no #00ff00 anywhere in the portal; crisp separable edges; opaque stone and metal; complete structure; western-wall 55-degree top-down three-quarter perspective; retain Image 1's visual identity but adapt its geometry to Image 2's world camera.
Avoid: front-on symmetrical presentation, orthographic UI icon, text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, characters, weapons held by characters, UI frame, card border, pedestal crop, floating debris, distant particles, fog, smoke, soft cast shadow, reflection, extra props.
worldSpaceVariants.postProcessing: Lanczos resize and transparent-canvas placement, then remove_chroma_key.py with soft matte, despill, and edge-contract 1

worldSpaceVariants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D ARPG world prop sprite for the east wall of the shared plaza
Primary request: Create one new world-only three-quarter-perspective version of the teal Memory Exchange portal. Re-author the portal from Image 1 for the plaza camera in Image 2; do not merely rotate or skew the existing front-facing UI asset.
Input images: Image 1 is the design-identity reference. Preserve its recognizable black carved masonry, aged-brass trim, balanced-scales crown, ledger desks, hanging seals and chains, dignified teal crystalline rift, and warm ivory core. Image 2 is the world-camera, material, scale, and lighting reference. Match its hand-painted dark gothic architecture and approximately 55-degree top-down three-quarter game view.
World orientation: This portal is installed against the EAST / RIGHT wall of the plaza. Its doorway faces WEST / LEFT toward the plaza center. The camera looks down from the southwest toward the northeast, so show the portal's front face in oblique three-quarter view plus believable depth on its southern/right-side masonry, threshold, buttresses, desks, books, and vessels. The structure should recede toward the upper-right and its base should sit on one coherent ground plane. It must read correctly as an east-wall world prop when composited into Image 2.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #FF00FF chroma-key background for later removal. No floor plane, horizon, cast shadow, contact shadow, reflection, gradient, texture, fog, or lighting variation in the magenta. Do not use #FF00FF anywhere in the structure.
Subject: exactly one complete monumental Memory Exchange portal, including its full crown, both side towers, full threshold and base, both ledger desks, books, chains, seals, and small brass vessels. Keep the teal rift contained inside the opening, with a restrained warm-white core. Maintain the same visual identity as Image 1 while redesigning every form to be spatially coherent at the requested angle.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D dark-fantasy action-RPG world sprite, early-2000s gothic ARPG atmosphere, blackened stone, forged iron, aged brass, crisp readable silhouette, natural wear, production-ready detail.
Composition/framing: square canvas; one centered isolated prop; entire silhouette visible; at least 9 percent clean magenta padding on every edge; no part touches or approaches a canvas edge. Target roughly 74 percent canvas height and 66 percent canvas width so the complete structure survives a 768 by 768 downscale.
Lighting/mood: match Image 2's warm low plaza lantern light on stone and brass, with the teal portal as the controlled magical accent. Preserve deep blacks and clear separation; no excessive bloom.
Constraints: complete uncropped structure; correct 55-degree top-down three-quarter perspective; east-wall orientation; no front-on orthographic presentation; no characters, creatures, players, nameplates, text, letters, numbers, signage, logos, watermark, UI panels, surrounding wall, surrounding floor, detached coins, loose props, extra portals, or decorative background. Keep a continuous clean chroma moat around every edge of the prop.
worldSpaceVariants.postProcessing: sharp Lanczos3 fit-fill resize, then remove_chroma_key.py with border auto-key, soft matte, thresholds 12/220, and despill

order: remove green chroma key and write final RGBA PNG

resize.equivalentOperation: sharp(input).resize({ width, height, fit: 'fill', kernel: 'lanczos3' }).png({ compressionLevel: 9, adaptiveFiltering: true })

chromaRemoval.intermediatePolicy: resized RGB intermediates were temporary and are intentionally not version-controlled
